invariants.title: We hear her breathe
invariants.rule: Her long breath out is audible under the dust and the rain.
invariants.why: The release IS the breath; the smile only confirms it.

invariants.title: The smile is a ghost
invariants.why: She got away with it; she does not celebrate.

invariants.title: It is H3
invariants.rule: The take in the film is H3's.
invariants.why: Her face holds in the gap's thin light.

flair.title: Take
flair.note: h3:11 - every take was faulted; this one the fewest

flair.title: Light
flair.note: a thin blade of orange across her eyes

title: the other side
beat: Nadia, squeezed into a gap between the crates, listens. A long breath out, and the ghost of a smile.
